about: Per-run records for the three configurations added to the Bitter Lesson figures on 2026-10-21, read from the rig workbench and the GPT-6 Astra (high) judge store. Hostnames removed; rig numbers kept. v1 is the grade on each task's rubric as used in the paper (Stand Up Bottles: the adapted 2026-09-22 rubric); v2 is the 8-level bottles rubric saved 2026-10-16, recorded for reference only. Gemini 3.7 Flash runs are not included: per Google's internal documentation its requests were served by Gemini 3.8 Flash.

Cap Pen.name: Cap Pen
Cap Pen.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end.

labels.description: Neither pen nor cap picked up.
Pen or cap picked up.
Pen and cap both held off the surface simultaneously.
Pen and cap touch while both are held in the air. No alignment requirement.
Cap successfully placed onto the pen and remains attached at trial end.

Classify Objects.name: Classify Objects
Classify Objects.guidance:
Grade the final state of the trial. There are two categories with three objects each and two baskets.
Assign a different category to each basket. If the setup specifies the assignment, use it. Otherwise either assignment is acceptable: use the assignment giving the higher total, with one basket per category. Do not count the same category in both baskets.
Score each basket separately:
0 - Empty, mixed (contains objects from both categories), or contains only objects of the category assigned to the other basket.
0.17 - One object of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
0.33 - Two objects of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
0.5 - All three objects of its assigned category, with no unrelated objects.
Add the two basket scores and select the matching total below. Mixed baskets always score zero. Maximum total is 1.0. Use the agreed decimal scores as written (for example, 0.17 + 0.17 = 0.34 and 0.33 + 0.33 = 0.66).

labels.description: Both baskets score 0.
Basket scores 0.17 + 0, in either order.
Basket scores 0.33 + 0, in either order.
Basket scores 0.17 + 0.17, for different categories.
Basket scores 0.5 + 0, or 0.33 + 0.17, in either order.
Basket scores 0.33 + 0.33, for different categories.
Basket scores 0.5 + 0.17, in either order.
Basket scores 0.5 + 0.33, in either order.
Basket scores 0.5 + 0.5: all three objects of each category in separate pure baskets.

Stack Bowls.name: Stack Bowls
Stack Bowls.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end. Overlapping means a bowl rests partly on another after release. For three bowls, all three must form one connected arrangement. Stacked means properly nested and stable.

labels.description: No qualifying overlap or stack at trial end.
Two bowls overlapping at trial end.
Two bowls stacked at trial end.
Three bowls overlapping in one connected arrangement at trial end.
Three bowls stacked at trial end.

Stand Up Bottles.name: Stand Up Bottles
Stand Up Bottles.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end.

labels.description: No bottles upright and no bottle successfully gripped and lifted.
A bottle gripped and lifted clear of its supporting surface.
One bottle upright at trial end.
Two bottles upright at trial end.
Three bottles upright at trial end.

Pack And Pour Fruit.name: Pack And Pour Fruit
Pack And Pour Fruit.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end. EXCEPTION: Packing scores 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 retain credit once achieved, even if later spilling or unsuccessful pouring undoes that progress. Count the maximum number simultaneously contained in the small bowl, not cumulative placements. Scores 0.7 through 1.0 require all three fruits to have been packed first; 0.7 requires lifting with all three still inside. Pouring credit requires transfer by pouring, not direct placement, and the poured fruit must remain in the large bowl at trial end. Examples: two packed then spilled = 0.3; three packed then spilled before lifting = 0.5; lifted with all three then all spilled = 0.7.

labels.description: No fruit successfully packed and no higher criterion achieved.
One fruit successfully placed into the small bowl.
Two fruits successfully contained in the small bowl at the same time.
Three fruits successfully contained in the small bowl at the same time.
Small bowl lifted clear of its supporting surface with all three fruits inside.
One fruit poured from the small bowl into the large bowl and remains there at trial end.
Two fruits poured from the small bowl into the large bowl and remain there at trial end.
All three fruits poured from the small bowl into the large bowl and remain there at trial end.

Store In Safe.name: Store In Safe
Store In Safe.guidance: Adapted rubric agreed 2026-09-22. Award the highest qualifying score; never add scores. Picked up/gripped and lifted means the held object visibly clears its supporting surface. Lifting and contact milestones retain credit once achieved. Unless explicitly excepted, upright, overlapping, stacked, and contained-object conditions must hold at trial end. No requirement to move the safe to the center of the table.

labels.description: No objects inside the safe at trial end.
One object inside the safe at trial end.
Two objects inside the safe at trial end.
Three objects inside the safe at trial end.
Three objects inside the safe and the lid closed at trial end.
